exposure: treatment for acute heart failure (oxygen-therapy, loop diuretics, aldosterone blockers, beta blockers, ACE inhibitors, bromocriptine)
cohort: A 32-year old female patient who developed acute heart failure and significantly reduced systolic function due to PPCM soon after a delivery of triplets.
finding: A 32-year-old woman who developed PPCM after a triplet delivery showed complete recovery of systolic function with no residual symptoms a year and a half after treatment.
